a.xlink:title: Sets M0/M1 for mode, then waits up to 200 ms for AUX to go high.
Changes the module's channel by rewriting REG2 (not saved to flash).
Configures the E22 module and leaves it in TRANS mode.
Powers up the module, writes cfg to its flash, verifies it, and enters TRANS mode.
Reads ADDH through REG3 from the module.
Sends the software reset command (CF) in CONFIG mode, then returns to TRANS.
Writes ADDH through REG3 to the module.
Reads one GND frame from the module and applies it. GND → FC data path.
Boot task (CubeMX's defaultTask): brings up every subsystem, then suspends itself.
Standalone radio link: sends barometer altitude through Telemetry::Update() every 10 ms forever.
Writes a new module config to flash and stores it in des_cfg.
Changes the module address (not saved to flash).
Changes the air data rate (REG0 bits 2–0, not saved to flash).
Changes the transmit power (REG1 bits 1–0, not saved to flash).
Changes the module's UART baud rate (REG0 bits 7–5, not saved to flash).
